subject: CAIQ intake: Hawthorne.ai instrumentation & sample log windows — scheduling and upload runbook
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@hawthorne.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Chan <matt.chan@hawthorne.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ & sample logs — intake and availability

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Hawthorne's security team is starting the CAIQ intake for our procurement checklist. We'll need the CAIQ spreadsheet filled, a short runbook describing how we can pull a 24-hour tokenized log sample, and a 1-hour demo window where we can watch log export and retention settings.

Top asks to plan for the call:
- 30–45 minute live demo (we prefer 8/11 or 8/12 morning PT)
- CAIQ spreadsheet completed (we attached v1 to this email)
- Sample log export: preferred windows and any PII redaction steps
- Contacts for technical questions during the call

I've attached our intake template (Hawthorne_CAIQ_v1.xlsx) and included a short notes file for log expectations (log-sample-readme.txt). Can you confirm who from Redwood will join and the available time slots?

Appreciate it — Lina

Lina Torres
Security Program Manager
Hawthorne.ai
(attachment: Hawthorne_CAIQ_v1.xlsx)
(attachment: log-sample-readme.txt)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@hawthorne.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ & sample logs — intake and availability

Hi Lina — great to hear from you. Thanks for the templates and the clear asks.

Short answers first: 8/11 09:30–10:15 PT works for us for the demo; we can also do 8/12 10:00–10:45 PT as a backup. Marissa (Security Intake) and Ben (Platform/Logs) will join.

Before the call we'll:
- Populate the CAIQ spreadsheet with baseline answers and mark questions that will need follow-up
- Prepare a script for the 24-hour tokenized log export demo and a sanitized sample (we will not include PII)
- Share a short runbook PDF and a link to the artifact folder ahead of the call

Attachments I will send ahead: redwood-caiq-checklist.pdf (baseline answers) and a short runbook. Can you confirm whether Hawthorne prefers S3 transfer or a Drive link for the sample?

I'll put the 8/11 slot on the calendar and send an invite with dial-in + prep notes.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Lead\Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-caiq-checklist.pdf)

From: Matt Chan <matt.chan@hawthorne.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@hawthorne.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 12:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ & sample logs — intake and availability

Thanks Soojin — S3 transfer is preferred for larger samples, Drive is fine for smaller artifacts. For the demo, we'll invite our cloud infra engineer in case we need a quick question on retention semantics.

Two small items:
1) On the CAIQ — we flag any control items related to "operator access to production logs" for an internal review. If you can call out who has that access, it'll speed up our legal review.
2) We typically request a signed NDA before we exchange tokenized samples; can you route that to security@hawthorne.ai?

I'll accept the calendar invite once it arrives.

-Matt

Matt Chan
Senior Cloud Engineer\Hawthorne.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@hawthorne.ai>, Matt Chan <matt.chan@hawthorne.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ & sample logs — intake and availability

Thanks Matt — noted on S3 and NDA. Marissa, can you coordinate the NDA to security@hawthorne.ai and attach to the invite? Ben, please prepare the export script and a sanitized sample (tokenized) and confirm size estimate.

Action items:
- Marissa: draft NDA and send to Lina
- Ben: export script + sample size estimate
- Soojin: fill CAIQ baseline + calendar invite for 8/11 09:30 PT

I'll include a short pre-read (redwood-caiq-checklist.pdf) in the calendar invite.

On the calendar invite I'll also add a short run-of-show: 5m intros, 20m demo/log export, 10m Q&A, 10m follow-ups.

Soojin
